scores.tell: Slightly low contrast; flat pale green stripes with no glow behind clock, but key and hero separation match real cards.
Whole card is dark teal-blue, with a dark navy hero and dark truss. Hero separation is weak and the corners are heavy, so it is darker than the bright real cards.
Train body is a big black mass, darker than the real cards. The sky and sand are bright, so the key is still close.
None. Bright purple background with a soft ring glow, and the yellow fins separate from it by both value and hue.
None. Radial burst gives a glow behind the hero, and the blue bottle contrasts with the orange.
Large near-black cauldron and dark grey floor tiles. The dark mass takes more of the card than real cards allow, though the green goo and flame accents help.
Mid-key grey ground with the pale rover sitting on it. Ground is a bit dull and dark in the lower half, and the hero is not set off by a glow.
Value is all mid-to-light green. The hero has little value separation from the hedge, and there is no glow.
Bright, saturated scene. Dock and water are similar in value, so the hero relies on hue, but the key is close.
